basic_info.description: Fabulously updated single-family home in the sought-after Central Richmond neighborhood. Extensively remodeled in 2022, the main level has a modern, open concept layout with a spacious kitchen and dining area, leaving ample room for a more formal living room. The kitchen is equipped with Miele appliances and modern European cabinetry from BauBox. A half bathroom and yard access complete this level. The upper floor has a coveted three-bedroom and two-bathroom layout. The primary bedroom has a huge walk-in closet and sumptuous en-suite bathroom, with soaking tub, rain shower and double vanity. There are two additional bedrooms on the lower level, ideal for in-laws, guests, or home offices, plus a full bathroom and a family room that has walk-out access to the sunny rear yard. Located on a corner, this semi-detached home is flooded with natural light. Smart features and upgraded systems include Nest thermostats, Lutron lighting controls, and in-ceiling speakers making this the ideal three-level home for today's lifestyle. Golden Gate Park and the Presidio are minutes away and a plethora of eateries, coffee shops and stores are nearby on Geary Blvd. Walk Score is 98!
